basis: Local detached-signature verification with the supplied Daniel Stenberg public key
Fingerprint and release-signing role match https://daniel.haxx.se/address.html
Daniel's page links the same fingerprint at https://keys.openpgp.org/vks/v1/by-fingerprint/27EDEAF22F3ABCEB50DB9A125CC908FDB71E12C2
The official curl download page publishes the 8.22.0 archive and its PGP signature

provenanceLimitations: GnuPG reported TRUST_UNDEFINED / an uncertified key; the fingerprint was checked against curl's official publications but no independent web-of-trust certification was established.

The official curl pages used here publish the archive and detached signature, but no source-archive SHA-256 value was located; the recorded SHA-256 is therefore an independently reproducible local digest, not an official checksum comparison.
No source was compiled, configured, or executed. curl's reproducible-release verification script was not run because this bounded check did not clone or execute source tooling.
This establishes archive identity and detached-signature provenance only; it does not qualify curl for product integration or establish absence of vulnerabilities.
qualification: Source and license provenance only. Native binary/package/source closure, installer and security gates remain pending under SCRUM-209 and SCRUM-211.
